plugins.name: seekerizer
plugins.description: Inline stock price ticker for the Claude Code status line, with skill-based watchlist management. Quotes from Yahoo Finance (no API key).

plugins.name: echogram
plugins.description: Meeting recorder: start/stop local recording with live transcription, transcribe with whisper.cpp, and turn it into structured minutes saved locally and optionally uploaded to Notion or Confluence.

plugins.name: telemetro
plugins.description: Monitor Claude Code usage: enables the built-in OpenTelemetry export and runs a local Grafana stack (grafana/otel-lgtm) to receive it — tokens, cost, sessions, tool events on a dashboard.
